# Milkdown Spike Third-Party License Snapshot

Generated from the temporary builder lockfile under `.tmp/milkdown-spike-builder`. This file documents the dev-only spike bundle; it is not a production dependency approval.

## Notes

- Primary packages: `@milkdown/core`, `@milkdown/preset-commonmark`, `@milkdown/preset-gfm`, `@milkdown/plugin-history`, `@milkdown/plugin-listener` @ 7.21.2 (MIT).
- Intentionally avoids `@milkdown/kit` because it pulls `@milkdown/components` / Vue into the spike bundle and currently hits an npm registry resolution failure for `@babel/parser@^7.29.7`.
- Webview bundle: 451510 bytes raw / 137986 bytes gzip.
- Round-trip verifier runs directly from `.tmp/milkdown-spike-builder/src/roundtrip-verify.mjs` against the temporary builder `node_modules`; it is intentionally not bundled because jsdom uses `require.resolve()` for internal assets.
- Generated `vendor/index.js` is a spike artifact, not a production dependency.
